name: Wedding Errantry -Gyakutama Ou-
original_name: ウェディングエラントリー -逆玉王-
source:
Seth is very indecisive with women. But as the quest for searching the proper groom for the princess of the kingdom is announced, Seth makes his move. The condition is clearing the training dungeon created by the court magician.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
赛斯对女人非常优柔寡断。但随着为王国公主寻找合适新郎的任务宣布，塞斯采取了行动。条件是通关宫廷魔法师创建的训练迷宫。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
